title: The leaves in the puddle
logline: The alley's puddle in October with maple leaves floating in it and the beer sign's neon under them. The Rain's first tier, in autumn, with leaves. The page has drawn this puddle in three seasons now.

panels.composition: A puddle in a gravel alley with yellow maple leaves floating on it and a tavern's neon beer sign reflected beneath them.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a puddle in a gravel alley with yellow maple leaves floating on it and a tavern's neon beer sign reflected beneath them, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
